SHARPENS IT, AND RETIRES EXACTLY ONE CLAUSE. That fact's name reads "n=1, MECHANISM IDENTIFIED, PREVALENCE UNMEASURED". The sweep it asked for has now been run: PREVALENCE IS MEASURED, and it is 1 of 312. Its own "n=1" was right and its "nobody has counted" is now false. Nothing else in it changes.

⭐ WHAT THE COUNT ADDS RATHER THAN CORRECTS, and it is bigger than what was counted: 279 of 312 facts carry NO `name`, so for 89% the handle a reader meets is the ID — and `name` is not a declared property of TemporalFact at all. Its mechanism sentence, "search_design returns the name rather than the bounded body", is TRUE and covers a ninth of the cases.

⚠️ AND THE COUNT WEAKENS ITS IMPLIED URGENCY, which is the honest reading. Stage 2 found the discipline mostly WORKING: a fact using the identical phrase "by construction" bounds its own headline explicitly and is not an overreach at all. A lint on that phrase would have fired on correct work.

🛑 WHAT STILL STANDS ENTIRELY: the mechanism, the exemplar, the observation that the exemplar bounded a different claim than its name, and the reading of `dec:reflow2-is-built-for-observability` as a rule stated about detectors and never about the design's own records. That last is untouched and is the part worth keeping.
